response_raw:
Factory_Pipeline
robots: robot1, robot2
locations: warehouse, surface_texturization_start, surface_texturization_end, laser_start, laser_end, loading_area
resources: raw_materials, texturized_materials, lasered_materials
robot1:
	default moveTo
	1: pick raw_materials until position(robot1, surface_texturization_start)
	2: moveTo surface_texturization_start
	3: pick texturized_materials until position(robot1, laser_start)
	4: moveTo surface_texturization_end
	5: pick texturized_materials until position(robot1, laser_start)
	6: moveTo laser_start
	7: pick texturized_materials until position(robot1, laser_end)
	8: moveTo laser_end
	9: pick lasered_materials until position(robot1, loading_area)
	10: deposit lasered_materials until !busy(robot1)
robot2:
	default moveTo
	1: pick raw_materials until position(robot2, surface_texturization_start)
	2: moveTo surface_texturization_start
	3: pick texturized_materials until position(robot2, laser_start)
	4: moveTo surface_texturization_end
	5: pick texturized_materials until position(robot2, laser_start)
	6: moveTo laser_start
	7: pick texturized_materials until position(robot2, laser_end)
	8: moveTo laser_end
	9: pick lasered_materials until position(robot2, loading_area)
	10: deposit lasered_materials until !busy(robot2)
success: time(600)
failure: time(2000) && position(robot1, loading_area) && position(robot2, loading_area)
